why_lead: Ether had the day's largest move among major crypto assets (+12.24% to 2,120.56 USD; +32.15% over 20 sessions) on a newly published, simple catalyst: BlackRock's ethereum trust plans fuelling ETF-filing speculation (n0771), with ether above $2,000 for the first time since July (n0948). Attention evidence: bitcoin past $36,000 on possible ETF approval (n0946), ARK/21Shares crypto-ETF launches (n0945), Hong Kong ETF coverage (n0947), price-target pieces (n0949) and Saylor's MicroStrategy rally story (n0834), with Coinbase, MicroStrategy and Marathon all higher on a risk-off equity day. Smart-money split from Balchunas (n0944) versus Deutsche Bank, FCA and Coinbase-scrutiny headlines (n0943, n0942, n0930); Powell's hawkish remarks and the weak 30-year auction (n1919, n1923, n0752) supply the macro break.
why_smaller: NuScale Power: -32.90% to 2.08 USD (-62.04% over 20 sessions) on the newly published cancellation of the first US small nuclear project after a 53% cost climb (n0801, n0847, n0879), with Cameco +4.38% and URA +2.42% the same day: a speculative-developer collapse, distinct from the 2023-11-07 operator item.

Walt Disney: +6.91% to 90.34 USD on newly published results with a $2 billion bigger cost-cutting plan and better-than-expected profit (n0616, n0614), against CNN's five-problems analysis and streaming competition (n0582, n1178): a household-brand turnaround narrative.

AMC: material update to the 2023-11-09 item, whose stated break (a close below $10) was triggered: newly published stock-sale and pay-vote headlines (n0756, n0757) and a 13.68% fall to 8.71 USD turn the story into dilution.
